newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian prime rate fell to 10.125 pct at end-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Italian prime rate fell to 10.125 pct at end-Oct.

text.p: The Italian banking system's average prime rate fell to 10.125 percent at the end of October, the Italian Banking Association ABI said.
ABI said in its latest monthly report that the reduction from 10.75 percent in September and August followed the Bank of Italy's 75 basis point discount rate cut to 7.5 percent on October 24.
The central bank's fixed-term advances, or Lombard rate, was also cut to 9.0 percent from 9.75 percent.
"The banking system promptly followed the signal from the monetary authorities with an immediate and almost across-the-board rate reduction," ABI said.
Such a rate cut "is being gradually applied throughout the entire structure of bank rates," it added.
